## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

⚠️ **Gate recommendation: approve with a non-blocking risk.**

Replacing the [retired preview default](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations) is justified, and [GPT-5.6 Sol supports the existing Chat Completions interface](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol). The regression fails on the base revision and passes here; local SDK transport checks also verify the default and explicit model requests, JSON parsing, and sorting.

The remaining risk is the model migration: no live OpenAI request was made, so ranking quality and latency/token cost with the new default remain unmeasured. Validate representative queries before adopting it in latency-sensitive search; callers can still select a model explicitly with `model_name`.

⚠️ **Gate recommendation: approve with a non-blocking risk.**

Updating the retired default and removing `temperature` remains compatible with the [row-alignment fix now merged from main](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4549). The request regression fails on the current base and passes here; all three targeted repository tests pass. Mocked SDK checks also pass for vector, full-text, and hybrid reranking in both score modes, using the default and an explicit model.

Live OpenAI ranking quality and latency/token cost with the new default remain unmeasured. Validate representative queries before adopting it in latency-sensitive search; callers can still select a model explicitly with `model_name`.

LGTM. Retires the gpt-4-turbo-preview default in favor of gpt-5.6-sol, stops sending temperature=0 (unsupported by GPT-5) and covers it with a mocked request test plus docs update. Verified against latest main; full CI passed.
